cards.front: ¿Por qué me lo estás dando a mí?
cards.back: Why are you giving it to me?

cards.front: Te lo estoy dando a ti porque es tuyo.
cards.back: I'm giving it to you because it's yours.

cards.front: No se lo estoy dando a él porque no es suyo.
cards.back: I'm not giving it to him because it's not his.

cards.front: ¿Por qué ella siempre se lo da a ellos?
cards.back: Why does she always give it to them?

cards.front: Ella siempre se lo da a ellos porque es de ellos.
cards.back: She always gives it to them because it's theirs.

cards.front: Ella nunca nos lo da a nosotros porque no es nuestro.
cards.back: She never gives it to us because it's not ours.

cards.front: ¿Por qué no te los darán a ti?
cards.back: Why won't they give them to you?

cards.front: No me los darán a mí porque no son míos.
cards.back: They won't give them to me because they're not mine.

cards.front: Se los darán a ella porque son suyos.
cards.back: They'll give them to her because they're hers.

cards.front: ¿Por qué se lo diste a ella?
cards.back: Why did you give it to her?

cards.front: Se lo di a ella porque era suyo.
cards.back: I gave it to her because it was hers.

cards.front: No te lo di a ti porque no es tuyo.
cards.back: I didn't give it to you because it's not yours.

cards.front: ¿Por qué se las han dado a ellas?
cards.back: Why have they given them to them?

cards.front: Se las han dado a ellas porque son de ellas.
cards.back: They've given them to them because they're theirs.

cards.front: No se las han dado a él porque no son suyas.
cards.back: They haven't given them to him because they're not his.

cards.front: Daría lo que fuera por un cigarrillo.
cards.back: I'd give anything for a cigarette.

cards.front: No sé lo que daría por un baño caliente ahora mismo.
cards.back: I'd give anything for a hot bath right now.

cards.front: Por un beso de la flaca daría lo que fuera, aunque sólo uno fuera.
cards.back: I'd give anything for a kiss from the skinny girl... even if it was just one.

cards.front: Daría lo que fuera por estar allí para ver qué pasa en su vestuario.
cards.back: I'd give anything to be a fly on the wall in their dressing room.

cards.front: No sé lo que daría por tener una cita con ella.
cards.back: I'd give anything to have a date with her.

cards.front: Daría lo que fuera por poder hablar otra vez con mi abuela.
cards.back: I'd give anything to be able to talk to my grandmother again.

cards.front: Daría lo que fuera por saber por qué no estuvieron allí.
cards.back: I'd give anything to know why they weren't there.

cards.front: Daría lo que fuera por saber lo que ella dijo cuando se lo dijeron a ella.
cards.back: I'd give anything to know what she said when they told her.

cards.front: Daría lo que fuera por saber con quién estuvo ella anoche.
cards.back: I'd give anything to know who she was with last night.

cards.front: ¿Qué darías por volver con tu exnovia?
cards.back: What would you give to get back together with your ex-girlfriend?

cards.front: ¿Qué darías por otras vacaciones en el Lejano Oriente?
cards.back: What would you give for another holiday in the Far East?

cards.front: ¿Qué darías por pasar una noche con ese actor?
cards.back: What would you give to spend a night with that actor?

cards.front: Daría mi brazo derecho por verla de nuevo.
cards.back: I'd give my right arm to see her again.

cards.front: Daría un brazo y una pierna por mi propia cama.
cards.back: I'd give an arm and a leg for my own bed.

cards.front: Daría la camisa que llevo por poder trabajar en esa empresa.
cards.back: I'd give the shirt off my back to be able to work in that company.

cards.front: La verdad es que no quiero aprender chino, pero le daré una oportunidad en cualquier caso.
cards.back: I don't really want to learn Chinese, but I'll give it a go anyway.

cards.front: ¿Hiciste un intento de hacer submarinismo mientras estuviste de vacaciones?
cards.back: Did you give scuba diving a go while you were on vacation?

cards.front: Siempre pruebo deportes nuevos antes de decidir si me gustan o no.
cards.back: I always give new sports a go before I decide if I like them or not.

cards.front: Hice el examen, pero no me esforcé al máximo.
cards.back: I did the exam, but I didn't really give it my all.

cards.front: Si queremos conseguir este contrato, tenemos que esforzarnos al máximo.
cards.back: If we want to get this contract, we have to give it our all.

cards.front: Se ha esforzado al máximo en la relación. Es una pena que esté terminando.
cards.back: He's given the relationship his all. It's a pity it's coming to an end.

cards.front: Estaba indecisa sobre la mudanza; necesitaba que alguien me diera un pequeño empujón.
cards.back: I was undecided about the move; I needed someone to give me a little push.

cards.front: Al casarse, su hermana le dio el empujón que ella necesitaba.
cards.back: Her sister gave her the push she needed by getting married.

cards.front: Él dice que no está seguro sobre la universidad. Necesita que le den un empujón.
cards.back: He says he's not sure about college. He needs to be given a push.

cards.front: Deja que te dé un consejo: intenta caerle bien.
cards.back: Let me give you a tip: stay on his good side.

cards.front: Deja que te dé un consejo: escucha a tu mujer.
cards.back: Let me give you a tip: listen to your wife.

cards.front: Deja que te dé un consejo: vigila los peniques y los dólares cuidarán de sí mismos.
cards.back: Let me give you a tip: watch your pennies and your dollars will take care of themselves.

cards.front: Conseguir un sobresaliente en esa clase me dio el empuje que necesitaba.
cards.back: Getting an A in that class really gave me the boost I needed.

cards.front: ¿Le dieron tus ánimos el empuje que necesitaba antes de la competición?
cards.back: Did your encouragement give him a boost before the competition?

cards.front: No deberías depender de las bebidas energéticas para darte un empuje todos los días.
cards.back: You shouldn't rely on energy drinks to give you a boost on a daily basis.

cards.front: Su padre la llevó al altar.
cards.back: Her father gave her away at her wedding.

cards.front: Él quiso llevarla al altar vistiendo un traje muy elegante.
cards.back: He wanted to give her away at her wedding wearing a very elegant suit.

cards.front: Sin embargo, al final él tuvo que llevarla al altar con un traje más modesto después de mancharse el bueno de sopa.
cards.back: However, in the end, he had to give her away in a more modest suit after getting a soup stain on the good one.

cards.front: Una mancha de carmín en el cuello de tu camisa siempre te delatará.
cards.back: Lipstick on your collar will always give you away.

cards.front: El olor a perfume de mujer siempre te delatará.
cards.back: The smell of women's perfume will always give you away.

cards.front: ¡Cuando hablas en tus sueños, sacas todo a la luz!
cards.back: When you talk in your sleep you give everything away!

cards.front: ¡Te dije que donaras toda esa ropa a la iglesia!
cards.back: I told you to give away all those clothes to the church.

cards.front: Ella me dijo que donara todos mis juguetes a los huérfanos.
cards.back: She told me to give away all my toys to the orphans.

cards.front: Le dijeron a ella que donara todas sus joyas a la caridad.
cards.back: They told her to give away all her jewelry to charity.

cards.front: Diez minutos antes de que acabara la película, Brett contó el final.
cards.back: Ten minutes before the end of the film, Brett gave away the ending!

cards.front: ¡Por favor, no cuentes el final como la última vez!
cards.back: Please don't give away the ending like you did last time!

cards.front: Como vuelvas a contar el final de la película, ¡no volveré a invitarte al cine!
cards.back: If you give away the ending of the film again, I won't invite you to the cinema again!

cards.front: Intentamos fingir que no sabíamos que era su cumpleaños, pero Anna lo estropeó todo.
cards.back: We tried to hide the fact that we knew it was her birthday, but Anna gave the game away.

cards.front: Procuramos actuar de forma natural en la noche de su fiesta, pero lo estropeamos todo.
cards.back: We tried to act naturally on the evening of her party, but we gave the game away.

cards.front: Quisimos fingir que no sabíamos que era su aniversario, pero Sandra lo estropeó todo.
cards.back: We wanted to pretend that we didn't know it was his anniversary, but Sandra gave the game away.

cards.front: Mi fuerza de voluntad es prácticamente nula, así que siempre sucumbo ante la tentación.
cards.back: My willpower is practically non-existent, so I always give into temptation.

cards.front: Es un niño tan encantador que los mayores siempre dan su brazo a torcer con él.
cards.back: He's such a charming little boy that grown-ups give into him all the time.

cards.front: Dijeron que fue un gran error ceder ante las amenazas terroristas.
cards.back: They said it was a big mistake to give into the terrorist threats.

cards.front: ¡Por favor, no pierdas la fe en mí! Prometo hacerlo bien la próxima vez.
cards.back: Please don't give up on me! I promise I'll do it right next time.

cards.front: No creo que recibamos más fondos de ellos. Dieron el proyecto por perdido hace tiempo.
cards.back: I don't think we'll receive any more funds from them. They gave up on the project long ago.

cards.front: Después de diez horas de interrogatorio improductivo, la policía dio al sospechoso por perdido.
cards.back: The police gave up on the suspect after ten hours of unproductive interrogation.

cards.front: Hay algo debajo de la cama que despide un olor raro. ¿Podrían ser tus calcetines, cariño?
cards.back: Something under the bed's giving off a funny smell. Could it be your socks, dear?

cards.front: Creo que guardan el tarro del café en ese armarito. Despide un olor riquísimo a café al abrirlo.
cards.back: I think they keep the coffee jar in that cupboard. It gives off a lovely coffee smell when you open it.

cards.front: ¿Cómo puede dar tanto calor una bombilla tan diminuta?
cards.back: How can such a tiny light bulb give off so much heat?

cards.front: A la paloma mensajera le falló su corazoncito antes de que pudiera llegar hasta la princesa.
cards.back: The homing pigeon's little heart gave out before reaching the princess.

cards.front: No me extraña que le fallara el hígado, ¡era una alcohólica empedernida!
cards.back: No wonder her liver gave out, she was a raging alcoholic!

cards.front: Aún se desconoce la razón por la que le fallaron los pulmones al experto buceador.
cards.back: The reason why the expert diver's lungs gave out is still unknown.

cards.front: No deberías abandonar tu dieta sólo porque sucumbiste al chocolate anoche.
cards.back: You shouldn't give up on your diet just because you gave into chocolate last night.

cards.front: Le sorprendería la luz tan potente que emite esta lámpara.
cards.back: You'd be surprised what a bright light this lamp gives off.

cards.front: ¿Se puede llevar una vida normal si te falla uno de los riñones?
cards.back: Can you lead a normal life if one of your kidneys gives out?

cards.front: ¿Por qué no damos un paso adelante y acompañamos nuestras declaraciones con acciones?
cards.back: Why don't we take a step forward and accompany our statements with actions?

cards.front: El presidente estaba convencido de que había llegado el momento de dar un paso adelante y firmar el acuerdo de paz.
cards.back: The president was convinced it was time to take a step forward and sign the peace agreement.

cards.front: Por fin ha dado un gran paso adelante y ha admitido su error.
cards.back: She has finally taken a big step forward and admitted her mistake.

cards.front: Damos muchas cosas por sentadas, como tener agua caliente cuando lo necesitamos.
cards.back: We take so many things for granted, like having hot water whenever we need it.

cards.front: Das por sentado que puedes ir al colegio, pero piensa en todos los niños que no tienen esa oportunidad.
cards.back: You take it for granted that you can go to school, but think about all the children who don't have this opportunity.

cards.front: No subestimes a Susan. Algún día alguien se va a fijar en ella y apreciará lo que tú no apreciaste.
cards.back: Don't take Susan for granted. One day someone will take an interest in her and appreciate what you didn't.

cards.front: Lo peor de ser policía es tener que dar una mala noticia a alguien.
cards.back: The worst thing about being a policeman is having to break the bad news to someone.

cards.front: ¿Quién le dio la noticia? ¡No debería haberse enterado!
cards.back: Who broke the news to her? She wasn't supposed to know!

cards.front: ¿Cuándo vas a dar la noticia sobre tu embarazo?
cards.back: When will you break the news about your pregnancy?

cards.front: Para la fiesta de esta tarde tenemos comida y bebida para dar y tomar.
cards.back: We have plenty of food and drink to spare for the party tonight.

cards.front: ¿Quieres fruta? Mi madre siempre tiene para dar y tomar en su casa.
cards.back: Do you want some fruit? My mother always has plenty to spare in her house.

cards.front: Pídeselo a Lucía. Ella siempre tiene bolis para dar y tomar.
cards.back: Ask Lucia for it. She always has plenty of pens to spare.

cards.front: Estoy pensando en regalar los cachorros. Dan mucho trabajo.
cards.back: I'm thinking about giving the puppies away. They're a lot of work.

cards.front: Cuando el señor Bromley se hizo mayor no podía cuidar el jardín porque le daba mucho trabajo.
cards.back: When Mr. Bromley grew old, he couldn't take care of the garden because it was too much work.

cards.front: Da mucho trabajo criar niños estando solo.
cards.back: It's hard work bringing up children alone.
